title: Not for a shower curtain
text:
Not for a shower curtain. These are quite thin. If light is shining, you can almost see through them. I don’t know how well they will hold up in the washing machine.

I didn’t purchase these to use as shower curtains. I don’t believe they are good enough quality for that. I am using one to hide the contents of a closet without a door. The other to separate my laundry room from my bathroom.
